items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Gibson called me and told me the fellows wanted me in the band... I'll come out and play with the band. And that's when I joined the band.

ctx.x: And he was a piano player. And he would sit in the room there, this lady, Mrs. Gibson, she had a piano. And he would start playing. He could really play. But --
